appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'United States vs Canada'.
x-axis is labeled 'Characteristic' and displays years from 2012 to 2020.
Blue solid line with circular markers represents United States data.
Red dashed line with square markers represents Canada data.
The 2013 data point for the United States is marked with a blue circle and labeled '1257.35'.
The 2013 data point for Canada is marked with a red square and labeled '434.33'.
